action.objective: Verify d1h5 at max depth to confirm the broad-search suggestion before committing, checking the queen raid's safety and whether Black refutes it.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested d1h5 (exact 245) ahead of b5d7 (199). No commit_ready moves exist yet, so verification is required. I use the reserved verification budget (2000 nodes) for d1h5 at full depth 4 to get safety.complete, immediate-mate probes, and a deeper exact score. If refuted or score collapses, replan to a safer developing/castling alternative. The queen raid's early-major penalty is a concern, but g7g6 reply gives Black a tempo to hit the queen; verification will clarify whether the extra e5 pawn and Black's uncastled king justify it.
